2608.20237.title: Rule-Compliant Visual Spatial Planning for Multimodal Large Language Models
2608.20237.paper_summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) combine linguistic reasoning with visual perception, yet their ability to perform visual spatial planning under explicit or previously unseen rule constraints remains underexplored. This setting requires models to jointly understand spatial layouts, interpret natural-language rules, and plan valid actions accordingly. To address this gap, we introduce RuleMaze, a controllable benchmark in which MLLMs must navigate mazes while obeying natural-language rules of varying complexity. RuleMaze isolates rule-compliant spatial planning by requiring accurate perception, rule interpretation, and constrained action planning. To enable scalable and systematic rule construction, we propose Language-Logic-Function Hybridization, which automatically generates natural-language rules and translates them into logical representations and executable validators, eliminating manual rule engineering. To improve rule following and generalization, we introduce Disentangled Multimodal Planning (DMP), which separates perception, execution, and rule verification through interpretable reasoning primitives. By disentangling these components, DMP facilitates systematic generalization to more complex and previously unseen rules, while providing transparent intermediate planning traces. Experiments demonstrate that DMP substantially improves rule compliance and planning success compared to end-to-end textual planning baselines. Overall, RuleMaze establishes a principled benchmark for studying grounded and interpretable rule-based spatial planning in MLLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/oceanflowlab/RuleMaze.
2608.20237.paper_summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）結合了語言推理與視覺感知，然而它們在明確或先前未見的規則約束下執行視覺空間規劃的能力仍然未被充分探索。這種情境要求模型共同理解空間佈局、解釋自然語言規則，並相應地計劃有效的行動。為了解決這一缺口，我們介紹了RuleMaze，一個可控的基準，其中MLLMs必須在遵循不同複雜度的自然語言規則的同時導航迷宮。RuleMaze通過要求準確的感知、規則解釋和受限的行動規劃，孤立了符合規則的空間規劃。為了實現可擴展和系統化的規則構建，我們提出了語言-邏輯-功能混合化，該方法自動生成自然語言規則並將其轉換為邏輯表示和可執行的驗證器，消除了手動規則工程。為了改善規則遵循和泛化，我們引入了解耦多模態規劃（DMP），該方法通過可解釋的推理原始體將感知、執行和規則驗證分開。通過解耦這些組件，DMP促進了對更複雜和先前未見規則的系統化泛化，同時提供透明的中間規劃痕跡。實驗表明，與端到端文本規劃基準相比，DMP顯著提高了規則遵循和規劃成功率。總體而言，RuleMaze建立了一個原則性的基準，用於研究MLLMs中基於規則的有根據和可解釋的空間規劃。代碼可在 https://github.com/oceanflowlab/RuleMaze 獲得。
